verdicts.reason: A keeps the text stack centred on the translucent band, which makes it read as one unit. But the band is much narrower than 'London' and the tagline, and it stops abruptly mid-canvas. The 'Save your money' line and both chevron rows sit straight on the busy skyline with weak contrast. The bottom half is just an empty cityscape with no brand content. B has the same faults and also breaks the composition: the headline and tagline drift to the left of the band, so the band no longer frames anything. The '<<<' chevrons float off to the right over towers, away from the copy, leaving the grid ragged and the elements scattered.
